steps.title: Method 1: top: 50% and a transform
steps.text: `top: 50%` puts the box's top edge at the middle, then `transform: translateY(-50%)` moves it up by half its own height. Switch the transform off: the box hangs from the middle, 120 px too low.
steps.textZh: `top: 50%` 把方块的上边缘放在正中，`transform: translateY(-50%)` 再把它往上移动自身高度的一半。关掉 transform：方块就从中线垂下来，低了 120 px。

watch.label: box centre, from the middle
watch.labelZh: 方块中心离中线的距离
watch.value: (() => { const box = document.querySelector('.content1').getBoundingClientRect(); const frame = document.querySelector('.container1').getBoundingClientRect(); return Math.round(box.top + box.height / 2 - (frame.top + frame.height / 2)) + ' px'; })()

steps.actionLabel: Switch the transform off or on

steps.title: Method 2: flexbox
steps.text: The parent is `display: flex` with `align-items: center`. Switch to `flex-start` and the box goes to the top, 30 px above the middle.
steps.textZh: 父元素是 `display: flex`，并设置了 `align-items: center`。切换成 `flex-start`，方块就跑到顶部，比中线高 30 px。

steps.title: Method 3: grid
steps.text: The parent is a grid, and the box has `align-self: center` and `justify-self: center`, so it is centred both ways. Switch `align-self` to `start` and it goes to the top.
steps.textZh: 父元素是网格，方块设置了 `align-self: center` 和 `justify-self: center`，所以在两个方向上都居中。把 `align-self` 切换成 `start`，它就跑到顶部。

steps.title: Method 4: an invisible second box
steps.titleZh: 方法 4：一个看不见的辅助盒子
steps.text: An empty `::before` as tall as the parent and the box share one line, and both have `vertical-align: middle`, so their middles line up. The parent's `font-size: 0` stops the space between them from taking room. Switch the box to `vertical-align: top` and it moves to the top.
steps.textZh: 一个和父元素一样高的空 `::before` 与方块排在同一行，两者都设置了 `vertical-align: middle`，所以它们的中线对齐。父元素的 `font-size: 0` 让它们之间的空格不占空间。把方块切换成 `vertical-align: top`，它就移到顶部。

steps.title: Method 5: a table cell
steps.text: `display: table-cell` with `vertical-align: middle` centres the line the box sits on, not the box itself. The line keeps some room below for letters such as g and p, so the box ends up a few pixels above the middle.
steps.textZh: `display: table-cell` 配合 `vertical-align: middle` 居中的是方块所在的那一行，而不是方块本身。这一行在下方为 g、p 这样的字母留了空间，所以方块最后比中线高出几个像素。
